title: Which Dwarf Is This? Doppeldwarf-306 and Near-Identical Instance Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.27490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most established instance-retrieval benchmarks emphasise landmarks; small sculptures from visually similar series offer a complementary challenge. We introduce Doppeldwarf-306: 1,691 openly licensed photographs of 306 bronze dwarf statues in Wroc{\l}aw, Poland, many made in themed series that share one style, with the photographer of each image recorded. With no training, nearest-neighbour search over frozen DINOv2 features names the right statue first for 93.1% of leave-one-out queries, and the best of thirteen backbones from seven pretraining paradigms reaches 94.7%. Accuracy falls slowly as candidates are added: for DINOv2, by about 0.8 points each time their number doubles. A natural design for a phone guide compares a photograph only with statues near the user. translated_title: 这是哪个小矮人？Doppeldwarf-306与近同实例检索
translated_abstract: 现有的实例检索基准大多侧重于地标建筑，而来自视觉上高度相似系列的小型雕塑则提供了一个互补性的挑战。我们介绍了Doppeldwarf-306数据集：包含1,691张开放授权的照片，拍摄了波兰弗罗茨瓦夫的306尊青铜小矮人雕像，其中许多雕像出自共享同一风格的主题系列，且每张照片的摄影师信息均有记录。在完全无需训练的情况下，对冻结的DINOv2特征进行最近邻搜索，即可在93.1%的留一法查询中首先命中正确雕像；在来自七种预训练范式的十三个骨干网络中，最佳者达到94.7%。随着候选数量的增加，准确率下降缓慢：对于DINOv2而言，候选数量每翻一倍，准确率仅约下降0.8个百分点。针对手机导览应用的一种自然设计是将查询照片仅与用户附近的雕像进行比较。在模拟实验中，这种设计确实有所帮助，但其效果不及同等数量的随机选取的雕像，因此随机子采样会高估其价值；置换检验将这一性能损失与……
tldr: 发布了包含波兰弗罗茨瓦夫306尊外观高度相似的青铜小矮人雕像的Doppeldwarf-306数据集，证明无需训练的冻结DINOv2特征最近邻检索即可达到93.1%的准确率，并揭示基于位置选取候选雕像的效果不如同规模的随机子集。
en_tdlr: Introduces Doppeldwarf-306, a dataset of 306 visually near-identical bronze dwarf statues in Wrocław, Poland, showing that training-free nearest-neighbour search over frozen DINOv2 features achieves 93.1% first-hit accuracy, and that location-based candidate subsets help less than equal-sized randomly chosen subsets.
